Description: Country fiscal uncertainty indices, all series, annual
Annual
245 economies, January 2016 to September 2026 (2026 is partial)
Long panel: one row per country and period (ISO3 x time)
Author's calculations from the GDELT Global Knowledge Graph (web news, English and ~65 machine-translated languages), data through 30 September 2026

Share of news articles tagged with uncertainty (U), economy (E) and fiscal (F) GDELT themes; country shares shrunk by empirical Bayes toward the country's own mean; index = 100 x share / 2016-2025 mean; _Z = within-series standardized log share over 2016-2025. See Appendix B of the paper.
Empty cell = no articles in the cell or series undefined
